answer.reason: The verses tell two chief deeds of Doeg beyond the summary: his report to Saul and his slaying of the priests at Nob.

clauses.english: told Saul he had seen David come to Ahimelech at Nob
clauses.quote: I saw the son of Jesse coming to Nob

clauses.english: slew eighty-five priests at Saul's command
clauses.quote: he fell upon the priests, and slew on that day fourscore and five persons

doubts: PSA 52:1 repeats the telling of Saul in a psalm title, so it was not cited separately.
